title: How Do I Look to a Bird?

collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — INNER LIFE, PART VI (101-120, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A seabird tips its head at a villager, and the villager wonders what they look like to a bird.

setup.name: The moment
setup.text: A seabird has landed on a rock nearby and is looking at (name1), with its head tipped to one side. (name1) looks back. And suddenly (he/she) wonders: what does (he/she) look like to the bird? Enormous, probably. Slow. Without wings, which must seem a very odd way to live. Maybe the bird thinks (name1) is a strange kind of tree that walks about. Maybe the bird thinks (he/she) is interesting. Maybe it doesn't think about (him/her) at all, and is just wondering whether (he/she) has any fish. The bird tips its head the other way. (name1) tips (his/her) own too. They stay like that for a while, two very different creatures, both wondering. Then the bird flies off, and (name1) never finds out.
